compute_rdp_single_tree: compute the RDP of a tree aggregation protocol for DP-FTRL given noise multiplier, rounds, max participation, and min separation
compute_zcdp: compute the zCDP parameter for a tree aggregation protocol given noise multiplier and squared sensitivity
get_dp_sgd_eps: compute the privacy epsilon for DP-SGD given noise multiplier, sampling rate, rounds, and target delta
get_dp_ftrl_eps: compute the privacy epsilon and zCDP for DP-FTRL tree aggregation given noise multiplier, rounds, participation, and separation
compute_gaussian_rdp: compute the RDP of a Gaussian mechanism given noise multiplier, sensitivity squared sum, and RDP orders
